_comment: Model catalog for ./run.sh. Edit this file to add models; run.sh reads it with jq and
never needs changing. `./run.sh --help` prints the alias list straight from here.
Every key under `defaults` is applied to every model unless the model overrides it.
`continuous_batching` must stay true: cli.py:252 leaves scheduler_config = None without
it, so max_num_seqs / cache_memory_mb / every kv_cache_* key is parsed and discarded.
There is deliberately no `downloaded` flag — run.sh probes the cache at runtime so this
Used by `--multi` and by the auto-merge path when a port is already busy.
memory_budget_gb is what makes 'load both, or evict one' a runtime decision:
models load lazily and are evicted per contention_policy when the budget is tight.
(model_registry.py:145) has no per-model parser fields — so every model merged onto
one port shares these. run.sh warns when a merged model wanted different ones.

tiny-0.6b.description: Qwen3-0.6B, 8-bit. Smallest — loads in seconds, use it to smoke-test the stack.
